regime_context: Detector shows a broad but shallow leadership structure in Canada: Oil & Gas Producers leads the rank on momentum/attention, with Consumer Staples & Retail and Big Banks close behind. Rotation margin is narrow (0.243), absorption is low (0.33), and the headline theme has poor breadth (0.429) and mixed durability, so this is not a clean one-narrative market.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Big Banks (durability 0.82, breadth 1.0, no crowding) sustains relative strength versus Consumer Staples & Retail (crowding z=1.01). The watch retires if ZEB.TO lags XST.TO by more than 3% over the next 15 trading days, or if Consumer Staples' crowding z breaks above 1.5 while breadth stays at 1.0.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples & Retail shows the strongest trend-quality profile of the eligible leaders: high durability (0.83), perfect breadth (1.0), and a trend hurst tag, which aligns with the detector's only validated edge (absolute-trend gate) favouring staying power. It carries a crowding flag (z=1.01), which under guardrails is a size-down caution only, not a fade. Rank/durability legs support this lean as a durable leadership expression.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.01 suggests attention/flow concentration that marks tops; consumer staples is a defensive rotation beneficiary that may lag if energy leadership reasserts or if rate-sensitive sentiment shifts.

falsifier.text: XST.TO trails XEG.TO by more than 5% over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks combine a top-3 momentum rank with strong trend quality: durability 0.82, perfect breadth 1.0, trend hurst, and no crowding (z=0.77). This is the cleanest 'staying power' profile among eligible leaders without the crowding caution attached to consumer staples. Trend-gate leg favours continued participation.
theses.dissent: Banks carry macro sensitivity to Canadian housing/credit and rate-path surprises; if the market's broad rotation narrows back into pure energy, financials could underperform despite their internal trend health.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO breaks below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive trading days

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Despite holding rank 1 and the highest score, Oil & Gas Producers has the weakest internal trend-quality of the top three: durability only 0.56, mixed hurst, and poor breadth (0.429). Narrow leadership plus rapid attention concentration makes this an unreliable anchor. Avoid expresses no directional bet, just a refusal to treat the leading rank as a durable overweight.
theses.dissent: Oil & Gas could continue to ride an energy supply/geopolitical bid (macro narrative shows geopolitics active); the absolute-trend gate is still eligible, and momentum rank may keep flows concentrated here near-term.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes above a new 60-day high with breadth expanding above 0.6 before the check-by date
